name: taarib-adapters-script
description: أدوات بناء ملحقات تعريب — the compilers for the two TypeScript adapters (rows I1 and I2 of docs/tawzee.md §3).
// esbuild: 0.28.2 emits row I1. It cannot emit row I2: `--target=es5` fails with
'Transforming const to the configured target environment ("es5") is not
supported yet', because lowering const/let to var is not implemented.
pnpm 10 blocks esbuild's postinstall and says so on every install. Harmless:
that script only verifies the platform binary its optional dependency
already installed, and `ibni.mjs` proves the binary works by running it.
// typescript: 6.0.3, not the 7.0.2 the studio uses, and this is the one place in the
repository that holds an older major on purpose. TypeScript 7 removed the
ES5 target outright — `tsc` answers TS5108 'Option target=ES5 has been
removed' — and row I2 has to be ES5 for RPG Maker MV's NW.js 0.12,
Chromium 41. 6.0 still emits it behind `ignoreDeprecations: 6.0`. When that
floor is raised, this pin goes with it and not before.
